digest.component_or_area: binding store recovery and reconcile boundary
propositions: A crash after retired tombstone replacement but before live replacement leaves the same exact identity live and retired, detectable but not repairable at construction or preview time.

Interrupted retirement states must be completed at the validated write-bearing reconcile boundary after staleness validation and before the first remote issue fetch, by moving recovery to binding_recovery.py and invoking once from reconcile.py.

Completion is safe and idempotent only when tombstone, forward entry, and reverse entry identities agree exactly; any mismatch, corrupt live file, or replace failure safety-aborts without side effects.
The durable tombstone is the committed side of retirement intent; explicit unretire removes it, while later automatic 200/clear_absent/same-key confirm does not implicitly resurrect it.
Construction, load, reconcile-check, dry-run, preview, selection, and filtered operations must perform zero writes from the retirement-completion operation.
Production code must use the narrow rich-emission facade operation instead of mutating bindings through all_bindings().
